jobs.label: Pieges-
jobs.caption: The actual seeded game board logic, followed by a headless start of the Tk interface. This checks rendering and board initialization, not a complete multiplayer match.
commands: import random; random.seed(42); from game import Plateau; p=Plateau(); assert len(p.trous)==2 and all(len(row)==49 for row in p.trous); print('Board: 7 x 7; 14 initialized sliders'); print('Open holes:', sum(a and b for a,b in zip(*p.trous)))
